events_summary.content: Medium close-up of Juliana seated at a rustic wooden table beside a daylight-lit window, gently touching an aged leather-bound book.

events_summary.content: Some of the pages are ruined. Careful.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: Mother spent years writing this.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: Yarrow.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: How do you know that?
Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive.
Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: You know more about healing than you let on.
Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Enough to survive.
